data.name: LowStock_Intro
data.value: These items are at or below their minimum stock. The ones that fell since the last email are marked as new.

data.name: LowStock_Footer
data.value: Lagerko sends this email at most once a day, when an item falls to its minimum stock or runs out.

data.name: ChannelFailure_Intro
data.value: Since {0} Lagerko can't connect to the shop {1}. Until it works again, stock from Lagerko isn't sent to the shop, and orders that didn't arrive right away are applied only once the connection works.

data.name: ChannelFailure_Reason_channel.unreachable
data.value: The shop can't be reached. Check that the site is up.

data.name: ChannelFailure_Reason_channel.unauthorized
data.value: The shop rejected the keys. Check whether they were revoked or their “Read/Write” permission changed, then replace them in Lagerko.

data.name: ChannelFailure_Reason_channel.not_woocommerce
data.value: WooCommerce is no longer found at the shop's address. Check that the plugin is active.

data.name: ChannelFailure_Reason_channel.unexpected_response
data.value: The shop answered unexpectedly. Usually a security plugin (e.g. Wordfence) or a cache is blocking the REST API.

data.name: ChannelFailure_Reason_Unknown
data.value: The shop didn't answer as expected.

data.name: ChannelFailure_Footer
data.value: Once the connection works, Lagerko carries on by itself. This email comes once per outage.

data.name: Invitation_Intro
data.value: {0} invites you to join {1} in Lagerko, the stock tracking app. Open the link, enter your name and a password, and you'll see the company's items and stock right away.

data.name: Invitation_Footer
data.value: The link works until {0} and only once. If you weren't expecting this invitation, just ignore the email.

data.name: PasswordReset_Intro
data.value: Someone asked for a new password for the account {0}. If it was you, open the link and enter a new password.

data.name: PasswordReset_Footer
data.value: The link is valid until {0} and works once. If you didn't ask for a new password, ignore this email: your old password still works.

data.name: RegistrationCode_Intro
data.value: Enter this code on the registration screen:

data.name: RegistrationCode_Footer
data.value: The code is valid for {0} minutes. If you didn't register a company on Lagerko, ignore this email: no account will be created.

data.name: NewRegistration_Footer
data.value: Only the platform's owner gets this email, when a new company registers.

data.name: Feedback_Footer
data.value: Only the platform's owner gets this email, for every message from a user.

data.name: Feedback_HasScreenshot
data.value: a screenshot is attached (see it in the app)
